description: This file defines the 'AboutActivity' class for an Android application. It manages a tabbed interface displaying information, contributions, and licenses about the app, utilizing fragments and a tab layout mediator. It also applies branding theming to the activity components.

classes.name: AboutActivity
classes.description: Main activity for displaying about information with tabbed sections.

classes.name: TabsStateAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing fragments in the tab layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the tab layout and adapter.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the activity's UI elements.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment based on tab position.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the Up button is pressed.
